clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Responds To Resignation Speculation
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran expressed an intent to resign to President Prabowo following a Supreme Court ruling concerning his diploma.
President Prabowo has reportedly advised the Vice President to pursue legal avenues to challenge the diploma ruling instead of resigning.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Bestows National Hero Titles to 19 Figures
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially granted the title of National Hero to 19 distinguished figures during the commemoration of Hero's Day.
The recipients include notable individuals such as guerilla commander Lieutenant Colonel Mochamad Sroedji, Kiai Haji Abbas Abdul Jamil, and Sultan Ibrahim Chaliludin.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Discharge Senior Officer Over Illegal Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police dismissed Irjen Ahrie Sonta after an ethics committee found him guilty of unauthorized wiretapping.
The investigation concluded that the former official committed professional misconduct regarding the surveillance of the President.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Faces Backlash Over Diploma Legal Plans
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka expressed readiness to resolve ongoing diploma verification concerns through the Administrative Court (PTUN).
Legal experts and officials caution that the move may be legally futile, noting that previous Supreme Court rulings on the matter are considered final.

clusters.headline: Hidayat Nur Wahid Resigns As Deputy Speaker Of The Indonesian MPR
aiSummaryBullets: Hidayat Nur Wahid officially resigned from his position as Deputy Speaker of the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) on November 10, 2026.
The Prosperous Justice Party (PKS) has appointed Mohamad Sohibul Iman to serve as the successor for the vacant deputy leadership role.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Ruling Cancels Gibran Rakabuming Raka Diploma Decree
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian Supreme Court has released ruling number 742 K/TUN/2026, which formally cancels the high school diploma equivalence decree of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
The court stated there is no evidence verifying the vice president holds an overseas educational certificate equivalent to a high school diploma.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Lawmakers Advance Opinion Rights Regarding Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Fifty members of the Indonesian House of Representatives have formally signed a proposal to initiate an opinion rights procedure concerning the Vice President.
Parliamentary leadership has acknowledged the petition while confirming they respect parallel legal proceedings currently underway at the Administrative Court.

clusters.headline: Government Officials Conduct Official Visit To Nagan Raya Regency
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Social Affairs Saifullah Yusuf praised the efficient operation of the Sekolah Rakyat facility in Nagan Raya.
Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian delivered disaster relief equipment, including high-pressure water pumps and heavy machinery.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Announces Winners Of The Pilah Olah Sampah Heroes 2026
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakarta provincial government recognized local environmental contributors through the Pilah Olah Sampah Heroes 2026 program.
Winners of the initiative will serve as ambassadors for the provincial government to promote waste management practices.

clusters.headline: Prosecutors Oppose Silmy Karim Legal Challenge In Extortion Case
aiSummaryBullets: Prosecution lawyers from the KPK have requested the court to dismiss a legal challenge filed by Silmy Karim.
The legal counsel for the accused argues that the absence of a sting operation makes the extortion charges difficult to substantiate.
